info.name: BoiAro — Presence & Live Users API
info.description:
APIs for reporting user presence from the mobile app and reading live user data in the admin panel.

**Base URL (production):** `https://boiaro.com.bd`
**Base URL (local):** `http://localhost:3001`

**Auth:** Set the `access_token` variable after login. All protected endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`.

---

## How it works

1. Mobile app calls **POST /api/v1/presence/heartbeat** every 45 seconds while the app is open.
2. Each heartbeat upserts a record in the `user_presence` table with `platform: "mobile"`.
3. Admin panel reads that table to show **Active Now / Online Now / Reading Now / Listening Now** counts.
4. A user is considered active if their `last_seen` is within the last **5 minutes**.

request.description:
Call this every 45 seconds while the app is open and the user is not reading or listening.

**When to call:**
- App launch
- User is on home/browse/library screen
- User closes a book

**Response:**
```json
{ "success": true }
```

Call immediately when the user opens a book to read, then every 45 seconds while they stay on the reading screen.

**Fields:**
- `book_id` — UUID of the book the user has open (required for this activity type)
- `current_page` — human-readable label: chapter name, page number, EPUB CFI, etc.
- `session_id` — stable UUID stored in device storage (same value across app restarts)

This makes the user appear under **Reading Now** in the admin panel.

Call immediately when the user starts playing an audiobook, then every 45 seconds while audio is playing.

**Fields:**
- `book_id` — UUID of the audiobook
- `current_page` — playback timestamp in `HH:MM:SS` format
- `session_id` — stable UUID stored in device storage

This makes the user appear under **Listening Now** in the admin panel.

Optional. Call when the app is in the background or paused. Interval can be stretched to every 120 seconds.

If the app stops sending heartbeats entirely (killed / no network), the user will naturally disappear from the live counts after 5 minutes.

query.description: Options: online | reading | listening. Omit for all active users.
Active window in minutes. Range: 1–60. Default: 5.

request.description:
Returns all users active within the last N minutes, enriched with profile and book info.

**Requires admin or moderator role.** The mobile app does NOT need to call this — it is used by the admin panel.

**Response fields:**
```
total      — total active users
reading    — count reading
listening  — count listening
browsing   — count browsing
users[]    — array of user objects
  user_id
  display_name
  avatar_url
  activity_type   reading | listening | browsing
  last_seen       ISO 8601 timestamp
  current_page    chapter / timestamp label
  session_id
  book
    title
    cover_url
```
